system_goal: Develop an image-to-editable-kern workflow for a church band, including melody, chord symbols and correct transposition. Investigate observed failures, choose informative experiments, measure the result and stop honestly when the goal is unmet.

task.approach: Preserve enlarged Audiveris melody and add an independent image-derived chord recognition pipeline using enlarged upper-staff crops, Tesseract, and constrained chord-symbol parsing.
task.objective: On the seven first-per-song pilot images, recover missing chord symbols without changing baseline melody. Inspect images and OCR bounding boxes, normalize root, quality, extensions and slash bass, and emit parseable editable kern with a harmony spine. Retain existing baseline chords when image evidence does not support replacement. Estimate chord onset from horizontal alignment with notation and explicitly mark uncertain timing in a separate audit artifact. Use available packages only; request_environment if a required dependency is missing.
task.success_criteria: Deliver sealed predictions for all seven pilot images, parse-validation results, and a per-image chord provenance table with crop coordinates, raw OCR, normalized symbols and timing uncertainty. Verify melody event sequences remain identical to the supplied baseline wherever parseable; report any baseline parse failure separately without inventing melody. Protected evaluation must compare chord error and melody error with enlarged Audiveris on the same seven images. Include a transposition round-trip check for melody and chord root/bass, identified as structural validation rather than measured musical accuracy.

hypothesis: Image-derived chord OCR and structured parsing can reduce chord deletions without increasing melody error; ambiguous symbols and onset alignment may remain unresolved.
expected_observation: More than eight matched chords and lower chord error than 0.78947, with unchanged parseable baseline melody. Spurious OCR chords or unsupported normalization would falsify the proposed benefit. Timing artifacts and round-trip checks will not establish audited timing or musician approval.
rationale: The paired enlarged baseline misses 30 of 38 chords while its eight predicted chords match. The source audit identifies absent text-to-harmony integration as a concrete failure. A chord-only intervention isolates this hypothesis and preserves the strongest measured baseline melody within the four-experiment budget.
